#### Equal, Same Group, or Different?

In this game you will decide how two elements relate. The game shows two elements: numbers, figures (circles and squares), or images. Choose one of the three buttons:

- **Equal** (light green button): the two elements are exactly the same.
- **Same group** (light yellow button): the two elements are not exactly the same, but they belong to the same group.
- **Neither** (light red button): the two elements are neither equal nor in the same group.

The game has seven levels. In the first three levels you compare numbers, so only two answers are possible: **Equal** or **Neither**. From the fourth level onward, figures and images appear, so all three answers are used.
